verdict.rationale: Bento documents trigger-based visual Workflows that branch, delay and make decisions, plus delayed email Sequences. These are started automatically by events, forms and tags, and can fire outbound webhooks, so automations run without manual intervention. The homepage also claims its AI can build flows from a plain-text description. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably unattended, and in-depth docs on the AI flow builder beyond the marketing claim.
